newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek mutual fund assets rise 4.2 mo/mo in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Greek mutual fund assets rise 4.2 mo/mo in Aug.

text.p: Greek mutual fund assets under management rose 4.21 percent month-on-month or 131.7 billion drachmas in August, Ionian Research said in its monthly review.

The increase was the outcome of a 123.1 billion drachma rise in money market and fixed income funds, a slight 0.1 billion drachma increase in the assets of international funds. Growth mutual fund assets also rose 8.5 billion drachmas.

The volume of mutual fund outstanding shares was up 2.79 percent in August as a result of inflows in money market and fixed income funds. But growth and international funds experienced redemptions, Ionian research said.
Overall, mutual fund net asset values rose 1.44 percent, the improvement seen in all categories of funds.

The Greek mutual fund universe had total assets of 3.257 trillion drachmas. Money market and fixed income funds made up 93.4 percent of the mutual fund market, growth funds accounted for 4.1 percent of the market.
International mutual funds continued to be the smallest portion of the mutual fund market at 2.5 percent, it said.
